content.short: NFTgo is an NFT data aggregator.
content.description: NFTgo, launched in September 2021, is an NFT data aggregator that helps users analyze the NFT market with a comprehensive suite of analytics tools. Explore market trend analytics, monitor NFT search engine rankings, assess rarity, follow whale activity, and track new drops to make informed buying decisions. For developers, NFTgo provides an API to access data endpoints and integrate NFTgo insights into their own applications.
